translation: The fu (跗) is the dorsum of the foot, also called the foot instep (足趺), commonly called the top of the foot (腳面); its bones are the bones of the proximal segments (本節) of the toes. The causes of its injury are not one: whether from falling from a height, or being struck and pressed by a heavy object, or being trampled and crushed by a carriage or horse. If only the sinews and flesh are injured, it is still relatively easy to treat; if the bone body is injured, it is often difficult to treat. First use manual technique to gently rub and knead, making the bones join and the sinews relax, wash with Haitongpi (Erythrina bark) and Baxian Xiaoyao (Eight Immortals Free-Wandering) decoctions, apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏), and administer internally medicines that relax the sinews and settle pain, as well as Jianbu Huqian Wan (Agile-Steps Tiger-Crouching Pill, 健步虎潛丸) and Bujin Wan (Sinew-Tonifying Pill, 補筋丸).
